remarks: SoNo Loft Living with RARE Garage Parking Now offered at $2,200 per month, this sun-filled loft-style residence combines classic SoNo character with a surprisingly private layout. Unlike many open lofts, Unit 2-H features a separate bedroom area divided from the living space by a wall-providing added privacy without sacrificing its bright, airy feel.  Southern exposure, hardwood floors, exposed brick and stainless-steel appliances add warmth and character throughout. One garage parking space is included-an exceptional convenience in the heart of downtown.  Located on the second floor of a walk-up building, the apartment is just steps from Washington Street restaurants, cafes, nightlife, shopping and the waterfront, with the South Norwalk train station nearby.  Highlights:  * $2,200 per month * Separate bedroom area * Southern exposure * Hardwood floors and exposed brick * Stainless-steel appliances * One garage parking space included * Second-floor walk-up * Convenient to Metro-North and the waterfront  Park the car. Drop the keys. Walk to dinner. Welcome to SoNo.
